findings.rule: the part talked about is lit
findings.problem: On "five on the left, five on the right" only the left side lights up (frame 17); the right-hand 5 of 5^{2x-2} stays white, so the student cannot see that the two bases match.
findings.fix: Make the right base its own token holding only the 5 (not "=5"), and light it together with the left 5 on "The bases match".

findings.rule: the part talked about is lit
findings.problem: On the left, the whole 5^{x+2} lights up, power included, so "the bases" is not shown as just the 5s.
findings.fix: Light only the base 5 on each side ("part": "sub" / base colour), keeping the powers unlit until beat 11 brings them down.

findings.rule: the part talked about is lit
findings.problem: The light on the plan line a^□ = a^△ ⇒ □ = △ cannot be seen: it stays the same cyan as when it was written (frames 06 and 18). So the student is not pointed back to the rule when the voice gives its reason.
findings.fix: Light the plan line in yellow (or another named tone that differs from its cyan) on "equal sides need", and in beat 3 on "powers must be".

findings.rule: the part talked about is lit
findings.problem: "The bases are five and twenty-five" lights the whole of both sides, powers too, so the student does not see which part of each side the base is.
findings.fix: Split the question line so the bases 5 and 25 are their own tokens, and light only those on "The bases are".

findings.rule: the part talked about is lit
findings.problem: "X is in the power" lights both whole sides, so the powers x+2 and x−1 are not singled out.
findings.fix: Light only the powers x+2 and x−1 on "X is in the power".

findings.rule: every move says what, how, and why
findings.problem: "The two joins the power" does not say which part is m and which is n in (a^m)^n = a^{mn}, so the student does not see why the new power is 2(x−1).
findings.fix: Say "here M is two and N is X minus one, so the power is two times X minus one", lighting the 2 and the x−1 as each is named.

findings.problem: While the 2 moves, the handwritten note labels ("Times power:" and the ↑ arrows) vanish and then come back (frames 14 to 15), so the board flickers.
findings.fix: Keep the notes' labels and arrows on screen during the move; only the moving 2 should change.

findings.rule: the part talked about is lit
findings.problem: "Take X from both sides and add two" lights no terms, so the student does not see which x and which 2 cross the equals sign.
findings.fix: Light the x on the left and the −2 on the right of x + 2 = 2x − 2 as they are named, and keep the same colours in 2 + 2 = 2x − x.
